worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = railroad retirement (person 0) 30,000.00 + long-term gains 20,000.00 = 50,000.00. Federal taxable income = 50,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 34,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Filing status single, no Montana standard deduction or exemptions. Schedule I Part I: line 7 additions 0.00; lines 22 and 23 railroad retirement 30,000.00; line 24 subtractions 30,000.00. Form 2 page 1: line 1 federal AGI 50,000.00; line 2 Form 1040 lines 12e and 13b 15,750.00; line 3 34,250.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 30,000.00; line 6 age 65 subtraction 0 x 5,660.00 = 0.00; line 7 Montana taxable income 34,250.00 + 0.00 - 30,000.00 - 0.00 = 4,250.00. Page 2 worksheet: line 1 4,250.00; line 2 net long-term gains 20,000.00; line 3 lesser 4,250.00; line 4 ordinary income 4,250.00 - 4,250.00 = 0.00; line 5 21,100.00; line 6 21,100.00 - 0.00 = 21,100.00; line 7 lesser of lines 3 and 6 = 4,250.00; line 8 3% x 4,250.00 = 127.50; line 9 4,250.00 - 21,100.00 = 0.00; line 10 4.1% x 0.00 = 0.00; line 11 127.50 + 0.00 = 127.50; line 12 ordinary income tax on 0.00: 4.7% x 0.00 = 0.00; line 13 127.50 + 0.00 = 127.50, carried to page 1 line 8. Bracket schedule as numbers (the expected figure): 4.7% x 4,250.00 = 199.75. Gains limited to taxable income: lesser of 20,000.00 and 4,250.00 = 4,250.00; extra rate -1.8% x 4,250.00 = -76.50; 199.75 - 76.50 = 123.25. Line 9 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 10 tax after credits 123.25. The form gives 127.50; expected keeps the projection's 123.25, a difference of 4.25 from 3% against 2.9% on the 4,250.00 of gains inside the first bracket, 4.25. Gains are limited to Montana taxable income after the railroad subtraction, not to the gains or to federal taxable income.
accepted_approximations: Montana taxes long-term gains at two rates, and the format holds one extra rate. Gains run through the ordinary brackets on top of ordinary income and pay an extra rate of -0.018 (4.1% less 5.9%). That is exact for gains above the first bracket, and gives 2.9% where the booklet says 3% for gains inside it. The gains must be limited to taxable income first (Form 2 page 2 line 3).
